name: SUMA Acquisition Corporation Units
summary: SUMA Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded by Naseem Saloojee and David King on November 21, 2025 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
